name: Ipak Yuli Bank Locator
tagline: Branch, ATM and minibank finder for Ipak Yuli Bank: clustered map, search and routes
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team for Ipak Yuli Bank

scenes.title: Every location, one tap away
scenes.body: Map, list, search and my-location shortcuts, with the interface in Uzbek, Russian and English.

scenes.title: 98 locations on a clustered map
scenes.body: Branches, minibanks and ATMs on one map; supercluster groups the pins and splits them as you zoom in.

scenes.title: Search by name, district or type
scenes.body: One-tap ATM, branch and minibank filters plus text search; the map refits, like 7 matches in Yunusabad.

scenes.title: Each location as an action card
scenes.body: Address, hours and an open or closed badge, with bank-app transfer, show-on-map and call buttons.

scenes.title: Details, directions and card orders
scenes.body: Distance from you, driving directions, one-tap call, and Uzcard, Humo and Visa orders via the bank's app.
